scope: Cross-cutting architectural decisions for absorbing Hermes' feature surface (M1-M4) into Arc's package model. Per-feature decisions deferred to follow-up /build runs.
report_source: Inline conversation 2026-04-18 (Hermes vs Arc comparison report)

decisions.D-01: ONE new sibling package: arcgateway. Modules in arcagent: voice, web, browser. Skills Hub extends arcskill (TOML+CLI gated). EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: MCP client, migration tooling, ACP/IDE adapter.
decisions.D-02: arcgateway = separate long-running daemon; one ArcAgent per chat
decisions.D-03: In-process asyncio task per chat; federal adds subprocess isolation
decisions.D-04: JSONL primary + SQLite FTS5 derived index (background-built)
decisions.D-05: Sessions in arcagent.modules.session; arcgateway depends on arcagent
decisions.D-06: Session identity = (user, agent). Same user across platforms = same session. Agent shares own memory across its sessions per ACL.
decisions.D-07: Per-session FIFO; no two-turn race; concurrent across different sessions
decisions.D-08: Skills Hub: TOML toggle ([skills.hub] enabled=false) + CLI-only install gate. No auto-install at federal.
decisions.D-09: Cross-session reads via per-session ACL (private/shared-with-agent/shared-with-others); tier-driven defaults
decisions.D-10: NL cron: deterministic parser first, arcllm fallback only on parse failure (federal disables fallback by default)
decisions.D-11: Subagent delegation: arcrun gains spawn() primitive; agent-facing tool lives in arcagent.tools.delegate
decisions.D-12: Skill auto-create nudge: new arcagent.modules.skill_improver.nudge submodule subscribes to event bus
decisions.D-13: ExecutorBackend protocol in arcrun; local+docker in core; ssh/modal/daytona/singularity as plugins
decisions.D-14: Platform creds: vault required at federal/enterprise; ~/.arc/gateway.toml 0600 at personal
decisions.D-16: Memory: two-tier — agent_memory (shared across sessions) + user_profile/{user_id}.md per user. ACL-gated per D-09.
decisions.D-17: Centralized slash command registry in arccli.commands.registry; consumed by all surfaces (arccli, arcgateway, arctui, platform adapters)

auto_applied: AUTO-1: TLS 1.2+ inter-package; mTLS at federal (NIST 800-52r2, SC-8)
AUTO-2: Every state-changing op audited (NIST AU-2)
AUTO-4: Vault-backed creds at federal (NIST IA-5)
AUTO-6: SBOM for all extras releases (EO 14028)
AUTO-7: AES-256 at-rest at federal (NIST SC-28)
AUTO-8: Voice transcripts = PII; bidirectional redaction at federal/enterprise (NIST SI-12)

notes: User overrides during walk: dropped arcmcp, arcmigrate, then on review also cut MCP/migration entirely (not even modules). Skills Hub stays with arcskill, gated by TOML+CLI.
User cut arcacp on review — IDE adapter not in roadmap; may ship later if demand emerges.

Final roadmap: ONE new sibling package (arcgateway) + arcagent module additions (voice/web/browser/skill_improver.nudge/session) + arcskill hub gating + arcrun ExecutorBackend + arctui Textual completion + arccli centralized command registry.
User reframed session model mid-walk: agent = person; sessions are (user, agent)-keyed and shareable across platforms for the same user.
User clarified delegation: arcrun.spawn() is the primitive; agent-side tool is just the surface.
